impression_before_control_comparison: An inverted woman appears to stand calmly on a brick ceiling above a normal sunlit street. Her body and impossible overhead foot support form the first-glance center; the lamppost and architecture supply a stable upright world.

criteria.evidence: The inverted full figure spans most of the frame from two ceiling shoes to head and free hands, while the normal street below remains upright. One support/gravity contradiction leads the whole image; no count of odd objects is used.

Native crop review-contact-native.png shows both black shoe soles individually meeting the overhead brickwork with local dark contact edges. Each connected trouser leg leads to the same inverted torso; the soles are neither nearby nor off frame.

The upright black lamppost at image right, receding paved street and curb, and rectangular building windows coexist below the inverted woman. These separate direction cues prevent a simple whole-image rotation reading.

Native face crop shows the visible face, dark eyes, short dark bob and fine separated fringe clearly. Relative facial proportions resemble the supplied portrait at this scale. Hair spreads under the inverted pose; no real identity or age is inferred.

perceived_surreal3: The impossible support relationship leads the image main impression, consistent with the frozen level-3 intended direction. This is a qualitative visual judgment, separate from technical metadata.

strengths: The body/ceiling contact and normal street orientation read together without explanation.
Warm masonry, cool charcoal clothing and light blouse organize attention around the inverted figure.
The reference face remains sufficiently large and clear for visible-feature comparison.
limitations: A still picture does not establish actual gravitational force, hidden-support absence or sustained physical balance. These claims are outside the visual test.
